claims.text: The dataset used includes Twitter data, which consists of tweets and associated metadata.
Emotion and sentiment lexicons were derived from the Twitter corpus, including the NRC Hashtag Emotion Lexicon and SentiWordNet.
GloVe embeddings trained on 2 billion tweets were integrated into the dataset.
